note: No official minimum elements for a CBOM exist yet. EO 14412 (June 22, 2026) directs CISA to publish them within 270 days (about March 2027). This rubric asks what a migration ticket needs. Change 'tier' to move a check between must and should, or set 'enabled': false; when CISA publishes, align the check list to it.

tiers.must: Without it there's no ticket: the engineer can't find the thing, size the fix, or pick the replacement.
tiers.should: Without it the ticket bounces back with questions.

checks.label: Exact location
checks.why: The engineer has to find the line. For code, the line must be right (±1); for files such as certificates, the right file.

checks.label: Correct parameters
checks.why: RSA-1024 and RSA-4096 are different tickets with different deadlines.

checks.label: Primitive, where the family is ambiguous
checks.why: RSA can be key transport (replace with ML-KEM) or signing (replace with ML-DSA); EC can be ECDH or ECDSA. Applies to RSA and EC only, where the name doesn't settle it.

checks.label: Certificate expiry (correct)
checks.why: Renewal is the cheapest migration window. Checked against the real certificate.

checks.label: Certificate subject (correct)
checks.why: Identifies which service or system the certificate belongs to.

checks.label: Key material type
checks.why: A private key on disk is an incident; a public key is an inventory line.

checks.label: Protocol version
checks.why: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.3 are different remediation tasks.

checks.label: OID
checks.why: Unambiguous identity across tools that name things differently.

checks.label: Crypto functions
checks.why: Sign, encrypt, derive: tells you which code paths to test after the change.

checks.label: Quantum security level (correct)
checks.why: Lets the CBOM be sorted by quantum exposure without re-deriving it.

checks.label: Code context
checks.why: The call or symbol, so the ticket shows what to change without opening the file.

checks.label: Providing library
checks.why: Many fixes are a library upgrade or a provider swap, not a code change.

checks.label: Certificate issuer
checks.why: Tells you which CA, and so which team, issues the replacement.

checks.label: Certificate start date
checks.why: Age of the certificate; flags long-lived certs.

checks.label: Certificate key and signature linked
checks.why: A PQ key under a classical signature is only half migrated; you can only see that with both.

checks.label: Key format
checks.why: PKCS#8, SEC1, OpenSSH, JWK: decides the tooling for rotation.

checks.label: Cipher suite in a protocol
checks.why: Suites belong to an endpoint's protocol config, which is what gets edited.
